name: picture-diary
description: Your coding agent keeps a daily diary of what went wrong, draws it as a kid's picture diary, and turns repeated mistakes into rules that have to prove themselves.
author: Dumb Game Lab

scripts.sample: node scripts/render.mjs docs/sample-ko.json --out docs/sample-ko.png && node scripts/render.mjs docs/sample-en.json --lang en --out docs/sample-en.png
